Method of Attack: Phishing via fake Android app masquerading as housekeeping service
Requesting excessive permissions including RECEIVE_SMS to intercept SMS OTP and MFA codes
Displaying fake login pages for Malaysian banks to steal banking credentials
Exfiltrating stolen credentials and intercepted SMS codes to attacker’s server
Impacted Systems: Customers of eight Malaysian banks' e-banking services
Attack Vector: Malicious APK installed from fake or cloned websites and social media accounts
Phishing login pages within the app mimicking real bank login pages
Indicators of Compromise: Fake or cloned websites and social media accounts promoting the app
Requests for at least 24 permissions including RECEIVE_SMS
Fake house cleaning reservation forms and payment method selection screens
Fake login pages for Malaysian banks hosted on attacker infrastructure
